title: Ride Sharing
subtitle: Find the nearest driver among millions of moving dots
motto: The matching is easy; keeping two million positions fresh is the hard part
coreAddition: geohash-sharded location store with hot-region splitting
keyInsight: Ride matching is a write problem: 666,667 location updates a second dwarf 116 match requests, and drivers cluster, so the load lands on a few shards.

decisions.title: Let the v1 design assume even load
decisions.description: The component frame shards by geohash and computes an even per-shard load, so the failure frame can show the skew that the assumption hid.
decisions.alternatives: Starting with a skewed load would explain the hot-spot problem before the reader has seen the design that suffers from it.

decisions.title: Price freshness against cost
decisions.description: The trade-off frame reports how far a driver moves between updates next to the shard count, since fewer updates cut cost but age the positions.
decisions.alternatives: Adding shards alone would hold the 3 second update rate at the cost of a much larger store.
